test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four girls A, B, C and D, and four boys P Q, R and S, are sitting around a round table facing the centre.

i. No two girls or boys are sitting next to each other.

ii. Q is sitting to the immediate left of B.

iii. S is sitting between A and D and is facing R.

Who is sitting between P and R?
solution:
**Four girls: **A, B, C, and D

**Four boys: **P, Q, R, and S

ii. Q is sitting to the immediate left of B.

iii. S is sitting between A and D and is facing R. There are two such cases,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc57862a8c9ac7f2bbab9a4d612e8e4dd1bad1d12fbc1e3160b5e06c6ba3113.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3691cd09bded37540735e40ccf5da3ba6c16f26a7a5ee32f94eff538a09cae83.png] 

i. No two girls or boys are sitting next to each other. Therefore, case II eliminates here and the final seating arrangement is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07653e46c8a2168b5a752ccbeaa111aca7f0440e28193c65e8e7d564b7c5d8b0.png] 

Hence, **C **is sitting between P and R.
